date.description: Its commit's (or tag's) date, in seconds.

CompareRef.description: A ref the Changes scope picker offers to compare: its full name.

current.description: The checked-out branch's full ref; none when detached.

upstream.description: Its upstream, when it has one.

near.description: The local branches nearest HEAD in its history, the newest first: the layers of a stack below it, then those above it.

refs.description: Local and remote-tracking branches, and the newest tags.
